title: Paginated REST API
description: Defective starter; make the behavior in task.md true without changing the tests. python3 stdlib; in-process request handler, no sockets.

starter.provenance: Authored for SDKit F05-A (2026-10). No third-party code. The defects are deliberate: see task.md for the required behavior.

requirements.text: `page` must be an integer >= 1 and `per_page` an integer from 1 to 100. Decimal ASCII only (no sign, whitespace, or fractions).
Items are ordered by ascending `id` (the store does not guarantee order), then sliced for the page.
A successful body is `{"items": [...], "page": p, "per_page": n, "total": N, "total_pages": T, "links": {"prev": ..., "next": ...}}`.
A page beyond the last one is not an error: `200` with `items == []` and the page echoed back.
Paging through all pages yields every item exactly once, in id order.
The 404 and 405 behavior stays as it is.
